Messages.Author: Vincent Crisafulli
Messages.Body:
Question (no matter how these get worded, they always sound like really bad
word problems):

Minion A is in combat with minion B. Minion A has potence, and minion B has
a weapon as equipment. Minion A strikes with Fractured Armament. Minion B
strikes with the weapon/equipment. Does minion B's weapon do it's
damage/effect before it is destroyed?

(Normally, with Fast Hands and Canine Horde, which have first strike,
there's no question. Fractured Armament seems... well... mildly retarted.)

-Vinnie!
